description: This Java source file defines the 'DeleteThingDefinition' command class, which represents a command to delete a 'ThingDefinition' of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes static factory methods for creating instances from JSON, as well as methods for serialization, comparison, and identification of the related resource.

classes.name: DeleteThingDefinition
classes.description: Represents a command to delete a specific 'ThingDefinition' associated with a 'Thing' identified by 'ThingId'. Implements serialization, equality, and resource path derivation methods.

methods.description: Returns a JSON pointer indicating the path to the 'definition/' resource related to this command.

methods.description: Returns the category/type of the command, here 'DELETE'.
